entries.title: Proverbs 17:1
segments: ¶Better [is] a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices [with] strife. {sacrifices: or, good cheer}

entries.title: Proverbs 17:2
segments: ¶A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:3
segments: ¶The fining pot [is] for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:4
segments: ¶A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; [and] a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:5
segments: ¶Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: [and] he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished. {unpunished: Heb. held innocent}

entries.title: Proverbs 17:6
segments: ¶Children's children [are] the crown of old men; and the glory of children [are] their fathers.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:7
segments: ¶Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince. {Excellent...: Heb. A lip of excellency} {lying...: Heb. a lip of lying}

words.text: . {Excellent...: Heb. A lip of excellency} {lying...: Heb. a lip of lying}

entries.title: Proverbs 17:8
segments: ¶A gift [is as] a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth. {a precious...: Heb. a stone of grace}

words.text: . {a precious...: Heb. a stone of grace}

entries.title: Proverbs 17:9
segments: ¶He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth [very] friends. {seeketh: or, procureth}

entries.title: Proverbs 17:10
segments: ¶A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool. {entereth...: or, aweth more a wise man, than to strike a fool an hundred times}

words.text: . {entereth...: or, aweth more a wise man, than to strike a fool an hundred times}

entries.title: Proverbs 17:11
segments: ¶An evil [man] seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:12
segments: ¶Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:13
segments: ¶Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:14
segments: ¶The beginning of strife [is as] when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:15
segments: ¶He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both [are] abomination to the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:16
segments: ¶Wherefore [is there] a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing [he hath] no heart [to it]?

entries.title: Proverbs 17:17
segments: ¶A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:18
segments: ¶A man void of understanding striketh hands, [and] becometh surety in the presence of his friend. {understanding: Heb. heart}

entries.title: Proverbs 17:19
segments: ¶He loveth transgression that loveth strife: [and] he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:20
segments: ¶He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief. {He that hath a froward...: Heb. The froward of heart}

words.text: : and he that hath a perverse
. {He that hath a froward...: Heb. The froward of heart}

entries.title: Proverbs 17:21
segments: ¶He that begetteth a fool [doeth it] to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:22
segments: ¶A merry heart doeth good [like] a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones. {like: or, to}

entries.title: Proverbs 17:23
segments: ¶A wicked [man] taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:24
segments: ¶Wisdom [is] before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool [are] in the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:25
segments: ¶A foolish son [is] a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:26
segments: ¶Also to punish the just [is] not good, [nor] to strike princes for equity.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:27
segments: ¶He that hath knowledge spareth his words: [and] a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit. {an...: or, a cool}

entries.title: Proverbs 17:28
segments: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: [and] he that shutteth his lips [is esteemed] a man of understanding.
